selection_reason: Small image-first file manager; good sanity check for whether orchestration adds unnecessary overhead on simple apps.
Official image-first object storage with clear HTTP console/API baseline; useful low-noise baseline.
Classic DB-backed web app with setup flow and frontend verification; representative common environment setup case.
Operator-facing Git service with DB/state initialization and login/admin baseline; not too large but more realistic than a static app.
Multi-service analytics app with DB/bootstrap/admin verification; good test for initialization and functional checks.
Historically failed before reaching runnable state; useful to test whether orchestration improves complex compose-style product setup.
Kubernetes-native project that previously succeeded; checks whether each approach can handle cluster-style deployment when feasible.
Representative Kubernetes control-plane/operator UI project with previous orchestration/tool interruption evidence.
Common observability UI with clear login/dashboard baseline; useful mainstream success comparator.
Historically exposed image/network and multi-service startup problems; useful for failure classification and retry behavior.
Library/tooling target where success depends on correct target selection, not just starting a generic container.
License-gated PHP CMS with provided license key; tests whether each arm can correctly consume supplied extras and complete deployment rather than only classify a missing prerequisite.
